questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Animals that have become extinct because of humans
How floods damage people's homes and businesses
Climate worry, and how to reduce it
Why newspapers only ever report bad news
questions.why: The programme is about eco-anxiety: grief, fear or hopelessness about the planet's future.

questions.q: According to the Institute of Psychiatrists, what can cause stress and anxiety?
options: Just reading news about the planet
Only living through a flood or a fire
Working in a green job for many years
Travelling by plane too often for work
questions.why: Beth says just reading about the planet in the news is causing stress and anxiety.

questions.q: How does Judy Ling Wong feel about young people today?
options: Angry that they don't do enough
Worried that they don't understand the science
Sure that they are too anxious to act
Very sympathetic, because older generations left a mess
questions.why: She says she has tremendous compassion for them because of the mess her generation left.

options: Because the climate is getting better
Because we now have exact science and know what to do
Because governments have solved the problem
Because fewer people are worried now
questions.why: She says now we have the exact science, and 'we actually know what to do now'.

questions.q: According to a paper Judy mentions, what helps people feel better?
options: Avoiding the news completely for a few weeks
Talking to a psychiatrist about their fears
Feeling part of a movement for change
Moving from the city to the countryside
questions.why: The paper said if you feel part of the movement to change things, you feel much better.

questions.q: What has the UK government promised, according to Judy?
options: To stop using all fossil fuels by 2030
To pay young activists
To plant 2 million trees
To create 2 million new green jobs
questions.why: She says they committed to creating 2 million new green jobs.

questions.q: Why does Judy mention green jobs?
options: Working for a green future helps your mind
They are much better paid than other jobs
Young people don't really want to do them
They are easy to find in most big cities
questions.why: She says dedicating your working life to a green future has a huge effect on your psychology.

options: Most people don't care about climate change
Most people are worried and ready to make changes
Only young people are worried
Most people think it's too late to act
questions.why: Beth says the majority are worried about climate change and prepared to make changes.
